scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of global uniqueness and exact formulas; finite rational replay is corroborative only. The 2008-02-01 date is the day-verified primary full paper, with an earlier July 2006 proceedings version whose public day is not verified.
scientific_limitations: Complete graphs of even order with one distinguished perfect matching, a shared linear conductance budget, two positive edge-price classes, and Kirchhoff-index objective only. The finite checker does not establish the general theorem. Independent audit has not been performed. Specialized historical equivalents cannot be excluded absolutely.
title: A sharp matching-price transition in resistance-optimized complete networks
